biggest_catch: The $200 comes as a Grizzlies Den gift card — usable only at the Grizzlies team store, not cash — and the offer expires September 30, 2026.
catches: Bonus is a $200 Grizzlies Den gift card, not cash; it is mailed to you and redeemable only at the Grizzlies Den (team merchandise), so its practical value depends on shopping there.
Offer expires September 30, 2026 — the account must be opened by that date.
Requires at least $300 in total qualifying direct deposits to post and clear within 90 days of account opening; missing the window forfeits the promotion entirely.

A qualifying recurring direct deposit is an electronic credit of salary, pension, government benefits, or regular monthly income from an employer or outside agency; P2P transfers (PayPal, Cash App, Venmo, Zelle), transfers between Pinnacle accounts in the same name, branch/ATM/online/mobile deposits, debit/prepaid card loads, and mailed deposits do NOT count.
New Pinnacle checking households only, or households that have not had an open Pinnacle consumer checking account for at least 24 months.
Limit one bonus per household; cannot be combined with other offers; non-transferable; account subject to approval.
Must be 18 or older at account opening.
The Grizzlies Basic Checking account carries a monthly maintenance fee if paper statements are used — choose eStatements to avoid it.
Bonus is reported as income on IRS Form 1099-INT and the customer is responsible for claiming it as interest income on their 2026 taxes.

steps: Open a Grizzlies Banking account online or at a Pinnacle location with a minimum opening deposit of $100 by September 30, 2026 (must be a new Pinnacle checking household, or no open Pinnacle consumer checking for at least 24 months).

Set up a recurring direct deposit of payroll or government benefits and have at least $300 in total qualifying direct deposits post and clear the account within 90 days of opening (P2P and internal transfers do not qualify).
The $200 Grizzlies Den gift card will be mailed to you within 2-4 weeks of meeting the requirements.
Claim the bonus as interest income on your 2026 taxes (Pinnacle reports it on Form 1099-INT).
timing: Offer expires September 30, 2026. At least $300 in qualifying direct deposits must post within 90 days of account opening. Gift card mailed within 2-4 weeks of meeting requirements.
